name: UnlockPage
author: lamcc21

sections.description:
UnlockPage provides flexible micropayment options for your paywalled content. It integrates with WordPress paywall providers to offer readers alternative payment methods for accessing premium content.

Features

  • Works on top of Leaky Paywall, with more paywall support coming
  • Custom Price Setting via dashboard
  • Flexible micropayment options for content access
  • Domain verification for security

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Copy over domain verification token and signing token from dashboard
  3. Set content available for payment in dashboard
  4. Then readers can pay for content via browser extension

Third Party Services

This plugin connects to the UnlockPage payment verification service to verify user payment status before unlocking premium content.

External Service: UnlockPage API (https://api.unlockpage.com)

Purpose: Verify that users have paid for content access through the UnlockPage payment verification system

Data Transmitted:
* Page URL (to verify which content is being accessed)
* Authentication proof token (from UnlockPage browser extension)

When Data is Sent: When a reader attempts to unlock paywalled content

Service Documentation:
* Terms of Service: https://unlockpage.com/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://unlockpage.com/privacy

This external service is required for the core functionality of the plugin. Without connection to the UnlockPage API, the plugin cannot verify payments or unlock content.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/unlockpage directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to UnlockPage in the WordPress admin menu
  4. Add your website in the UnlockPage dashboard at https://unlockpage.com/
  5. Copy the verification token and signing token, then paste it in the plugin settings
  6. Click “Save Token” and verify your domain in the UnlockPage dashboard
